title: cbuild_presets
description: A kit's ready builds, stored in the _cbuild_presets product meta. Each fills every required slot and names only the kit's own slots; the plugin checks both against the slots document.

schema_version.description: The document's version. Version 1 is the only one so far.

name.description: The owner's name for the build.

description.description: A line on who the build is for.

image.description: From 1.0.0, a rider photo for the build's tile, an attachment's id. Without one, the tile shows the build's composed picture (D-252).

picks.description: A part's id by slot key.
